text:
maria: kicking off a config-only rollout now — routing limits + timeout tighten + batching cap. Deploy bot: https://deploys.redwood.internal/1726234567 :rocket:
maria: change window 20:00-21:00 PT. canary to 1% on dedicated nodes, model pinned to v2.3.1 for stability.
deploy-bot: rollout initiated: stage=canary pct=1 target=dedicated-gpu-pool-3 config=cfg/2026-03-21/batch-timeout-tight.json
ben: quick q — what's being changed exactly (timeouts/batch/window)?
maria: request_timeout_ms: 1200 -> 1000, max_batch_size: 64 -> 48, batching_window_ms: 20 -> 15. purely config.
anya: note: last time reducing batching_window caused kv-cache pressure and small tail spikes. Add a p99 alert at baseline+35% and errors >0.5% rule.
dino: can we scope canary to us-west only to reduce blast radius?
maria: yep scoping to us-west-2 tenants. config excerpt:
```yaml
routing:
  region_scope: us-west-2
limits:
  max_batch_size: 48
  request_timeout_ms: 1000
batching_window_ms: 15
```
deploy-bot: canary deployed to us-west-2, pct=1, health checks started.
infra-observability-bot: canary metrics -> p50=115ms p95=305ms p99=520ms errors=0.02% token_cost_delta=-0.4%
ben: p99 520ms is within expected (~515 baseline). keep monitoring.
anya: adding auto-rollback: rollback if errors_pct > 0.5 OR p99 sustained > baseline*1.35 for 5m. attach runbook: https://wiki.redwood/ops/config-rollbacks
maria: applied auto-rollback rule. also added pager to #eng-oncall.
deploy-bot: auto-rollback rule registered and alerting hooked. next step: expand to 5% in 10m if stable.
dino: infra thumbs up — recommend holding model pin for 24h post-rollout before unpin.
maria: agreed, will keep v2.3.1 pinned for 24h.
ben: release notes blurb?
maria: added: "Config-only: tighten request timeout to 1000ms, reduce max_batch_size to 48, shorten batching window to 15ms. Scoped canary to us-west-2. Auto-rollback on error spike or p99 regression."
deploy-bot: after 10m at 1%: canary healthy, p95 delta +2ms, errors stable. progressing to 5% now.
anya: monitoring dashboard open, will call oncall if thresholds breach.
maria: will post final status when fully rolled or if rollback happens. :thumbsup:
